title: Time Jump: 12:00 — Verification Phase Begins

fields.narration: It is now 12:00. The control system remains isolated, and the plant is operating in full manual mode under 24/7 oversight. The HMI continues to display outdated values, but field measurements confirm pH has normalized to 7.8 and caustic dose is 4.0 mg/L — within safe limits. The lab has confirmed two clean sample rounds, and the Ohio EPA DDAGW has authorized the beginning of the verification phase. The next phase begins: Restoration & Verification.
worldState: Field measurements confirm pH is 7.8 and caustic dose is 4.0 mg/L — within safe limits.
Two clean sample rounds have been confirmed by lab (24-1191, 24-1192).
The Ohio EPA DDAGW has authorized the verification phase under ERP Section 13.
The Incident Commander has activated the verification checklist (ERP-13.1).
The system is still in full manual mode; no return to automatic is authorized yet.
fields.facilitatorNote: This jump marks the transition to the final phase of the incident. The players must now execute the verification and return-to-service process. Watch for premature attempts to restore automation or to rely on HMI data without verification.
